name: Busuu
what: Language-learning app with self-paced courses in ~14 languages plus community feedback from native speakers
pricing: Premium: $10.50/mo monthly; $62.99/yr ($5.25/mo); 6-month plan in between (web prices; app-store prices can be ~30% higher); free Basic tier
funding_or_revenue: Acquired by Chegg for ~$436M (EUR 385M) all-cash, announced Nov 2021, closed early 2022; had raised only ~$16.1M total before exit
accent_or_pronunciation_features: AI-powered review lessons; speech/pronunciation exercises; community feedback on spoken answers (UNVERIFIED for dedicated accent scoring)
notes: Owned by Chegg (NYSE: CHGG). No standalone accent-scoring product; pronunciation features are course add-ons.

name: Memrise
what: Vocabulary/speaking app built around native-speaker video clips and AI chatbots ("AI Buddies") in 130+ languages
pricing: US App Store: monthly plan listed $24.99/mo (raised to $39.99 Oct 2025 per tracker); annual $61.99-$99.99; lifetime ~$119.99-$249.99 with frequent discounts
funding_or_revenue: ~$25M raised total over 7 rounds; latest Series B $15.5M Jun 2018 (Octopus Ventures, Korelya Capital); 2017 revenue $6.3M
accent_or_pronunciation_features: Pronunciation practice via native-speaker videos and AI Buddies role-play; speech recognition for speaking practice (no regional-accent scoring)
notes: Pricing is volatile and A/B-tested; PCMag called $59.99/mo list price 'atrocious' (Apr 2025). Private company, London.

name: Rosetta Stone
what: Immersive language-learning software (Dynamic Immersion), 25 languages, web + mobile
pricing: Monthly $19.99/mo; Yearly $13.25/mo billed $159/yr; Lifetime $299 (frequently discounted to ~$179)
funding_or_revenue: Owned by IXL Learning since Mar 2021 (acquired from Cambium Learning Group; terms undisclosed)
accent_or_pronunciation_features: TruAccent speech-recognition engine scores pronunciation against native speakers; adjustable strictness; Live Lessons/Coaching with native speakers
notes: TruAccent is the closest shipped analog to accent scoring, but targets pronunciation not regional/dialect identification.

name: Cambly
what: On-demand 1-on-1 video English tutoring with native speakers (adults + Cambly Kids)
pricing: Per-lesson pricing: ~$18.75/lesson monthly, $12.12/lesson quarterly, $8.65/lesson yearly (30-min lessons, varies by lessons/week); older minute-based plans ~$30-110/mo
funding_or_revenue: ~$60M raised (Series B Jun 2022, Benchmark + Bessemer); $250M valuation in 2020; cash-flow positive since ~2017; est. revenue $19M (LinkedIn, UNVERIFIED)
accent_or_pronunciation_features: Automated feedback after every lesson; lesson recordings + transcripts; 'Unlimited pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary activities'
notes: Human tutors, not AI characters; English-only. Pronunciation feedback is a feature, not a game.

name: Preply
what: Marketplace connecting learners with human tutors for 1-on-1 online language lessons
pricing: Tutors set rates; English tutors average $15-25/hr; platform commission 100% of trial lesson, then 33% declining to 18% with hours taught
funding_or_revenue: Series D $150M (Jan 2026, WestCap) at $1.2B valuation; ~$299M total raised to date
accent_or_pronunciation_features: No native accent/pronunciation scoring; tutor feedback only (UNVERIFIED beyond marketing pages)
notes: Commission model: 100% of trial lesson + 33%->18% of ongoing lessons (help.preply.com commission article).

name: italki
what: Marketplace for 1-on-1 lessons with community tutors and professional teachers in 150+ languages
pricing: Teachers set prices $5-$120/lesson (min $5 community tutor / $10 professional); commission 21% single lesson, 15-19% packages, 30% group classes, 0% trials
funding_or_revenue: $3M Series A from Hujiang (2016); earlier undisclosed angel round (2012); acquired Lingbe (2019)
accent_or_pronunciation_features: No built-in accent scoring; pronunciation correction left to individual teachers (UNVERIFIED)
notes: Hong Kong/Shanghai-based; very low disclosed funding vs competitors.
